shortDescription: The Baltic Exchange's dry bulk freight index fell on Wednesday hurt by weaker rates across larger vessel segments.

children: The Baltic Exchange's dry bulk freight index fell on Wednesday hurt by weaker rates across larger vessel segments.
, which tracks rates for capesize, panamax and supramax vessels, fell 33 points, or ~1%, to 3,327 points
The capesize index (.BACI) dropped 75 points, or 1.3%, to 5,612 points.
Average daily earnings for capesize vessels (.BATCA), which typically transport 150,000-ton cargoes, including iron ore and coal, decreased by $675 to $47,397.

Meanwhile, iron ore prices rose slightly reversing earlier losses, as investors shifted focus from demand prospects in top consumer China to possible stimulus measures from Beijing and supply cuts among some small-sized miners.
The panamax index (.BPNI) fell 39 points, or 1.6%, to 2,325 points.
Average daily earnings for panamax vessels (.BPWT), which usually carry 60,000 to 70,000 tons of coal or grain, fell $349 to $20,927.
Among smaller vessels, the supramax index (.BSIS) was up 12 points, or 0.7%, at 1,748.
